title: Ultimate Kerala Highlands & Backwaters Tour Package
shortDescription: Discover the magic of God's Own Country in 2026. Explore Munnar's mist-covered tea estates, spot wildlife in Thekkady, and cruise the Alleppey backwaters on a luxury houseboat.
highlights: Scenic drive through Cheeyappara waterfalls and tea estates
Hidden Gem: Parunthumpara (Eagle's Rock) panoramic viewpoint
Wildlife safari and spice plantation tour in Thekkady
Luxury overnight houseboat cruise in Alleppey
Comfortable premium hotels with private transfers
overview: Escape into the heart of Kerala on this expertly optimized five-day itinerary. Start in Kochi and ascend into Munnar's rolling tea gardens. Journey south through the hidden gem of Parunthumpara to the spice hub of Thekkady for a wildlife experience. Conclude by unwinding aboard a traditional deluxe houseboat gliding through Alleppey's peaceful backwaters. Featuring premium accommodations and seamless private transport, this tour offers the perfect balance of adventure and relaxation.
accommodation: 2 nights premium 4-star hotel (Munnar), 1 night premium hotel (Thekkady), 1 night deluxe AC houseboat (Alleppey). Twin/triple sharing.
transportation: Private AC sedan/SUV with a professional chauffeur for all transfers.
meals: Breakfast (Days 2-5). Alleppey houseboat includes all meals (Lunch, Evening Snacks, Dinner, Breakfast).
weather: Pleasant year-round. Munnar is cool (12°C-24°C); Thekkady & Alleppey are tropical (22°C-33°C).

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Ascent to Munnar
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Kochi Airport/Railway Station. Meet your chauffeur and begin the ascent into the Western Ghats.
itinerary.afternoon: Stop at the cascading Cheeyappara and Valara Waterfalls. Enjoy fresh coconut water while viewing the lush spice gardens.
itinerary.evening: Check into your Munnar resort. Enjoy a relaxed evening walking through the local bazaar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Estates & National Park
itinerary.morning: Visit Eravikulam National Park to spot the endangered Nilgiri Tahr against the backdrop of Anamudi Peak.
itinerary.afternoon: Explore the Tea Museum, Mattupetty Dam, and Echo Point. Enjoy a serene boat ride on Kundala Lake.
itinerary.evening: Return to the resort for a warm dinner in the cool mountain climate.

itinerary.title: Hidden Gems & Spice Plantations
itinerary.morning: Drive towards Thekkady. En route, detour to the hidden gem of Parunthumpara (Eagle's Rock) for sweeping canyon views.
itinerary.afternoon: Check in at Thekkady. Enjoy a guided spice plantation tour, learning about cardamom, pepper, and cinnamon.
itinerary.evening: Experience Kerala's rich culture with an optional Kathakali or Kalaripayattu martial arts show.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Houseboat Backwater Cruise
itinerary.morning: Descend from the hills to the coastal plains of Alleppey. Board your traditional private houseboat.
itinerary.afternoon: Cruise the emerald backwaters, passing paddy fields and local villages. Enjoy an authentic Keralite lunch onboard.
itinerary.evening: Watch the sunset from the deck, followed by a romantic dinner and overnight stay on the water.

itinerary.title: Kochi Heritage & Departure
itinerary.morning: Enjoy a floating breakfast before disembarking the houseboat at 9:00 AM.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive to Fort Kochi. Explore the Chinese Fishing Nets, Jew Town, and Mattancherry Palace.
itinerary.evening: Transfer to Kochi Airport for your onward journey.

inclusions: Private AC vehicle with expert driver
2 nights in Munnar, 1 night in Thekkady

faq.question: What makes this optimized route better?
faq.answer: This route minimizes driving time by following a natural loop: Kochi -> Munnar (hills) -> Thekkady (forests) -> Alleppey (coast) -> Kochi, ensuring no backtracking.

faq.question: Is the Alleppey houseboat safe for children?
faq.answer: Yes, our houseboats are fully safety-compliant and highly recommended for families.

title: Gokarna, Dandeli & Murudeshwar Coastal Adventure

Transition to the laid-back hippie vibes of Gokarna for a famous beach trek. We've optimized the return route to include a stop at the hidden gem of Mirjan Fort, before admiring the colossal Murudeshwar Shiva statue and floating through the Honnavar mangroves. A flawless blend of thrills, spirituality, and relaxation.

transportation: AC Tempo Traveller / SUV for local sightseeing.
weather: Tropical and pleasant. 20°C to 34°C.

itinerary.title: Kali River Adventure in Dandeli
itinerary.morning: Arrive in Hubballi and drive straight to the Dandeli jungle camp. Freshen up and grab breakfast.
itinerary.afternoon: Gear up for white-water rafting on the Kali River. Try kayaking, zorbing, and wild swimming.
itinerary.evening: Campfire, music, and a hearty buffet dinner by the river.

itinerary.title: Vibhuti Falls & Gokarna Sunsets
itinerary.morning: Drive towards Gokarna. En route, take a short hike to the pristine Vibhuti Falls for a refreshing dip.
itinerary.afternoon: Arrive in Gokarna. Visit the Mahabaleshwar Temple, then head to Kudle Beach for lunch and relaxation.
itinerary.evening: Watch a spectacular sunset at Om Beach. Check into your beachside resort.

itinerary.title: The Ultimate Beach Trek
itinerary.morning: Embark on the famous Gokarna Beach Trek covering Paradise, Half Moon, and Om Beach.
itinerary.afternoon: Free time for cafe hopping, relaxing in hammocks, or trying out beachside water sports.
itinerary.evening: Stroll through Gokarna's flea markets and enjoy a seaside dinner.

itinerary.title: Mirjan Fort, Murudeshwar & Departure

title: Ultimate Coorg & Chikmagalur Coffee Hills Tour
shortDescription: A highly optimized weekend route covering Karnataka's highest peaks in Chikmagalur, the lush coffee estates of Coorg, and the heritage of Mysuru.
highlights: Stand atop Mullayanagiri, Karnataka's highest peak
Hidden Gem: The tranquil Hirekolale Lake in Chikmagalur
Off-road Jeep Safari to Mandalpatti in Coorg
Optimized circular route to minimize travel fatigue
overview: We have re-engineered this itinerary to provide the ultimate geographical flow. Starting from Bengaluru, you'll head directly to the towering peaks of Chikmagalur, visiting the hidden gem of Hirekolale Lake. Day two takes you south to the misty coffee plantations and waterfalls of Coorg. Day three concludes with a seamless drive through the royal city of Mysuru back to Bengaluru, eliminating backtracking and maximizing your time in nature.

transportation: AC Tempo Traveller / Innova for the entire circuit.

itinerary.title: Bengaluru to Chikmagalur Peaks
itinerary.morning: Depart Bengaluru early. Drive to Chikmagalur. Visit the historic Belur Temple en route.
itinerary.afternoon: Trek up to Mullayanagiri Peak for sweeping views of the Western Ghats.
itinerary.evening: Visit the hidden gem: Hirekolale Lake for a quiet sunset. Check into your Chikmagalur hotel.

itinerary.title: Chikmagalur to Coorg Wilderness
itinerary.morning: Drive to Coorg. Head straight to the cascading Abbey Falls surrounded by spice estates.
itinerary.afternoon: Take a thrilling 4x4 Jeep ride to Mandalpatti peak for dramatic valley views.
itinerary.evening: Watch the sunset from Raja's Seat. Check into your Coorg nature resort.

itinerary.afternoon: Drive down to Mysuru. View the majestic Mysore Palace and stop for local shopping.
itinerary.evening: Return to Bengaluru, completing a perfect geographical loop.

title: Complete Tamil Nadu Hills: Coimbatore, Ooty & Kodaikanal
shortDescription: The ultimate 5-day Tamil Nadu hill station expedition featuring the Adiyogi statue, Ooty's tea gardens, and the misty pine forests of Kodaikanal.
highlights: Blessings at the 112-ft Adiyogi Shiva Statue

After exploring Coonoor's tea estates, you'll take a scenic drive down and back up into the misty, pine-covered cliffs of Kodaikanal, stopping at the idyllic Mannavanur village.

transportation: Private AC Sedan/SUV for the entire trip.
weather: Cool year-round (10°C to 24°C). Light woolens recommended.

itinerary.title: Adiyogi & Ascent to Ooty
itinerary.morning: Pickup from Coimbatore. Visit the magnificent Isha Yoga Center and Adiyogi Statue.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive up the Nilgiri Ghat roads. Check into your Ooty hotel.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy an evening boat ride on Ooty Lake and visit the Botanical Gardens.

itinerary.title: Avalanche Lake & Coonoor Vistas
itinerary.morning: Visit the hidden gem: Avalanche Lake, a pristine, uncrowded natural reserve.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive to Coonoor. Visit Sim's Park, Dolphin's Nose, and Lamb's Rock overlooking the plains.
itinerary.evening: Return to Ooty. Try homemade Nilgiri chocolates at Charing Cross.

itinerary.title: Epic Drive to Kodaikanal
itinerary.morning: Early checkout. Begin the scenic drive descending from the Nilgiris and ascending the Palani Hills to Kodaikanal.
itinerary.afternoon: Stop at Silver Cascade Falls. Check into your Kodaikanal resort.
itinerary.evening: Take a leisurely stroll along the famous Coaker's Walk.

itinerary.title: Pillar Rocks & Mannavanur
itinerary.morning: Visit the majestic Pillar Rocks, Pine Forest, and Guna Caves.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive to the hidden gem of Mannavanur Sheep Farm for rolling green meadows and a serene lake.

itinerary.title: Descent to Coimbatore & Departure
itinerary.morning: Visit Kurinji Andavar Temple and grab some eucalyptus oil from the market.
itinerary.afternoon: Begin the descent back to Coimbatore.
itinerary.evening: Drop-off at Coimbatore Airport/Railway Station.

faq.question: Why is Jibhi added after Manali?
faq.answer: Jibhi and the Tirthan/Banjar side lie naturally south-east of Manali. Placing Jibhi after Manali allows the route to descend through Kullu and Aut instead of returning to Manali later.

faq.question: Why are two nights kept in Kasol and Manali?
faq.answer: These are the two larger sightseeing bases. Two nights prevent the itinerary from becoming a hotel-changing exercise and allow enough time for both the Parvati Valley and Manali–Lahaul circuits.

faq.question: Is Jibhi suitable for families?
faq.answer: Yes. Jibhi is particularly suitable for travellers looking for a quieter mountain environment, short nature walks, waterfalls and village experiences.

faq.question: Can Rohtang be included?
faq.answer: Rohtang can be added when officially accessible and the required permit and vehicle conditions are satisfied. Atal Tunnel and Sissu remain the planned Lahaul-side experience.
